payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterative DP computing completion times C[i][j] = max(C[i-1][j], C[i][j-1]) + processing time, with in-place array update for each painter.
payload.rationale: The solution implements a classic 2D DP recurrence for flow shop scheduling, where the state is picture index and painter index, compressed to a 1D array per step.
